basis: Date withheld by deterministic source validation (Invalid verified disclosure for 0000047111_2025-03-30: invalid date or numeric upper bound). Original assessment: In the Q4 2024 prepared remarks, Hershey’s CFO said, “First quarter total company net sales are expected to decline mid-teens” as Hershey lapped the prior year’s inventory build and early Easter. This explicitly covered consolidated reported Q1 2025 net sales. The entire mid-teens decline exceeds the 5% threshold. Hershey gave no exact numerical endpoint, so upper_bound is null.

coverage.detail: The November 7, 2024 Q3 release updated the full-year 2024 sales outlook. It gave no Q1 2025 consolidated sales forecast.
The Q3 prepared remarks anticipated 2025 sales growth in line with Hershey’s long-term target. That expectation covered the year.
The November 7 Q&A discussed 2025 sales and earnings expectations without quantifying a Q1 2025 total-company sales decline.
The January 10 CEO succession release reaffirmed the 2024 full-year outlook and said Hershey intended to give its 2025 outlook with February earnings.
The February 6 Q4 release forecast at least 2% net sales growth for full-year 2025 and announced the same morning’s prerecorded management discussion.

Page 5 gives the qualifying Q1 total-company forecast. Page 4 separately forecasts mid-teens organic, constant-currency declines for North America Confectionery and International. The consolidated conclusion comes directly from page 5.
At the February 6 live Q&A, investor relations confirmed that both the prerecorded remarks and their transcript were already on Hershey’s website.
The February 18 CAGNY announcement reaffirmed the February 6 full-year sales and earnings outlook.
The February 20 8-K exhibit announced a notes offering and supplied no Q1 sales update.

The May 1 release’s consolidated income statement reported net sales of $2,805,419,000 for the quarter ended March 30, 2025, versus $3,252,749,000 for the quarter ended March 31, 2024. The reported decline was 13.8%, and sales were below the $3,090,111,550 cutoff.

publication_date_evidence: The prepared transcript bears February 5. Hershey’s February 6 earnings release scheduled public posting of the recording for approximately 7:00 a.m. Eastern that day. At the 8:30 a.m. Eastern Q&A on February 6, investor relations confirmed that the recording and transcript had been posted.
